runs.overview: The handbook covers HR only through Workday AI, SAP Joule, Oracle Fusion agents and LinkedIn Recruiter, so it misses specialist recruiting suites, payroll and HCM agents, learning platforms, AI video for training and the intranet and employee-experience layer. Seven candidates survive verification. Near-misses skipped: Paradox (falls under Workday AI), Moveworks (overlaps ServiceNow Now Assist) and Oracle Recruiting (covered under Oracle Fusion AI Agents). Cornerstone Galaxy AI was removed because no adoption evidence could be opened. Most analyst placements are vendor-reported.
removed_or_corrected: Removed Cornerstone Galaxy AI (Workforce AI): the cited page has no Gartner placement or customer evidence, and the Gartner inclusion was seen only in search results.
ADP Assist: dropped the unopened FY2026 call-transcript claim (1.1M clients, 3.1M users); kept only the opened award evidence, which is weak (vendor-reported, inaugural award program).
Docebo: dropped the Fosway/Gartner/IDC leader claim, as no opened page supports it; the Q3 2025 customer wins and the Zoom, Booking.com and AWS customer names are verified.
Docebo: corrected the security list to include ISO 9001 and note FedRAMP Moderate applies to US Gov.

Eightfold: the pages opened once decoded; the Gartner Visionary and Fosway Strategic Leader claims are now verified as vendor-reported. Dropped the customer list (Vodafone, Chevron, etc.) as unverified. Confidence raised from low to medium.

HeyGen: Fortune 100 share differs between sources (AWS Marketplace 80%, vendor blog 85%); both are noted as self-reported. The enterprise_data_note is replaced with the AWS Marketplace statement that customer data is never used for model training and that it is SOC 2 Type II.

Synthesia: corrected customers to Merck, Mondelez International, Nexity, with SAP and Merck KGaA as DAX 40 examples. Heineken appears only as a linked case study. The enterprise_data_note still reflects the ISO certifications only.
Simpplr: updated to the 2026 Gartner MQ (four years running) and the Forrester Wave Q2 2026 per the opened vendor page; the sources entry now notes that the press-release page shows the 2026 banners.
Darwinbox: noted the source is branded content and the MQ title includes 1,000+ Employee Enterprises. Overall verdict stands at medium confidence.

iCIMS: corrected 'serves many Fortune 500 firms' to the vendor wording and added the BrightSpring Health Services name. No other change; the Leader placement was verified on the vendor page and the report date on Oracle's page.
runs.verification_notes: I opened every cited vendor page and independent sources where available (the Oracle page for the Gartner report title and date, the Nasdaq release for Docebo wins, the AWS Marketplace page for HeyGen). Most adoption and analyst-placement claims are vendor self-reported; the only independent corroboration is Oracle's page confirming the Gartner TA report and its date. No candidate duplicates a covered tool under another name; the stated overlaps are partial (Workday AI, LinkedIn Recruiter AI, Glean, Canva Magic Studio) and each candidate has a distinct scope. Confidence is high only where the vendor page states specific figures or customers that I read directly (Synthesia, Simpplr, iCIMS).
